notes: eval-0 (equipment) decisive: without_skill 0/4 built duplicate custom Equipement/Intervention DocTypes; with_skill 4/4 routed to ERPNext Asset via the spec->implementation map.

eval-2 (RG14) was the iteration-1 regression (with_skill 3/4 < baseline 4/4): the with_skill run added a proactive guard but omitted the v15 batch-negative-stock mechanism. FIXED in iteration-2 by sharpening the domain skill's RG14 entry ('already realized by the stock layer; describe v15, don't add a disponible flag') -> with_skill now 4/4.
Both configs are full agents WITH repo access, so the baseline often recovers answers by reading code; the skills' marginal value concentrates on architecture decisions and avoiding wrong defaults.
Cost: with_skill averages slightly more tokens (reads SKILL.md + references). Wall-clock durations are CONFOUNDED (runs executed concurrently) — tokens are the cleaner cost signal.
User feedback (iteration-1, partial): positive on eval-0/eval-1 ('worked well with skills, didn't work without').
